novelty_falsifiers.claim: Nonbreeding individuals can reoccupy breeding areas and provide defense or temporary incubation/guarding assistance
Existing breeding subcolonies can occupy mounds and ridges formed by historical pebble nest and guano accumulation
novelty_falsifiers.source: Schmidt et al 2021 Scientific Reports DOI 10.1038/s41598-021-94861-7

novelty_falsifiers.claim: Artificially constructed suitable mounds can be followed by breeding recolonization after station cleanup
Conspecific reproductive outcomes can supply public information for breeding site selection
Prior unsuccessful local pioneer nests and then nearby group formation occur in source literature

three_competing_mechanisms.H1_failed_attempt_patch_engineering: A genuinely failed egg-laying attempt increases next-season NEW adjacent breeding over ecologically matched NEVER-USED patches by leaving persistent physical substrate, with no local chick recruitment.
three_competing_mechanisms.H2_success_only_information: Only patches with at least one independently confirmed successful crèche/fledge in prior season increase next-season first-settlement, consistent with settlement decisions informed by reproductive success.
three_competing_mechanisms.H3_static_site_quality: After matching pre-choice rocks, snow, dry substrate, aspect, historical group density, predator pressure and census effort, past local outcome classes have no distinct predictive value.

minimum_discriminating_risk_set.stratum_never_used: must be independently surveyed empty but physically usable before 2021; blank site list cannot be assumed empty
minimum_discriminating_risk_set.stratum_verified_failed_attempt: at least one witnessed egg or hatch and independently documented failure, not simply no crèche observed
minimum_discriminating_risk_set.stratum_verified_success: confirmed chick at crèche or fledging with documented effort
minimum_discriminating_risk_set.prior_cue_measurement: record pebble mound topography, substrate, guano, visual social cues in an exposure window before new colonizers arrive
minimum_discriminating_risk_set.subsequent_settlement: independently identified first breeding attempts in the same fixed 3-10m patch ring
minimum_discriminating_risk_set.source_origins: marked individuals or independent first breeding status needed to distinguish recruitment, prebreeder prospectors and site fidelity
minimum_discriminating_risk_set.causal_exposure: independently timed natural changes or ethical permitted interventions required before any causal label

forbidden: Do not interpret a nonbreeding territory as a verified failed nesting attempt
Do not treat cr_confirm=0 as certain biological nest failure
Do not compare only old GPS-labeled nests as if unsampled nearby open ground were surveyed negative
Do not relabel experimental artificial nesting mounds and public-information site selection as unknown 2026 mechanisms
Do not infer arrival times from observer sighting dates or origin of unbanded adjacent nesters
Do not treat a synthetic positivity diagnostic as a field estimate
Do not use 25MB unverified Ross mark-resight mirror to bypass frozen PR142 source identity
Do not alter scientific freeze PR189
